checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.why: 640x352 is about 16:9 and the image looks complete.

must.item: Large shocked human face on right
must.why: Big close-up of a young gamer with wide eyes, open mouth and hands on cheeks, wearing a headset.

must.item: Headline reads exactly ONE LAST TRY, no extra words
must.why: Three lines read ONE / LAST / TRY, with no other words.

must.item: Headline on left, high-contrast, not covering face
must.why: White letters with a thick black outline sit on the left. They do not overlap the face.

faults.what: Low resolution (640px wide), slightly soft for YouTube.
Background has some messy paint-like clutter on the left, with faint controller shapes.
The face and hands look slightly airbrushed, as AI images often do, but there are no clear distortions.

summary: A bright, punchy blue-and-yellow thumbnail with a correctly spelled "ONE LAST TRY" on the left and a big shocked headset gamer on the right, held back mainly by its low resolution.
